acceptanceCriteria: The ratchet check fails when the count of definitions outside Requirements grows
The per-spec move plan is recorded
body: Follow-up from the spike lane (2026-10-21, branch claude/batch-spike; the evidence is in docs/build-log/2026-10-21-*.md once that batch lands). V1-0659 measured 4926 definitions: 648 sit outside '## Requirements' across 14 specs (cem-stable-v1 237, test-source-analysis-v0 198). The ticket's figure of 79 was NOT_OBSERVED. Recommendation: add a ratchet so the count never grows, then make per-spec moves. Re-home the 8 leases-spec overflow definitions rather than raise the 256 cap (see V1-2165).

title: Ratchet check for requirement definitions outside '## Requirements', then move them per spec
